seams.name: SecretFilesFileOps external I/O port

sixBar.B1: Secrets plugin must operate on host projects and box projects while preserving clone/path safety and tracked-file refusal.
sixBar.B2: Removing this transport boundary would make box paths use host filesystem/git and violate actual caller-visible secret synchronization.

sixBar.B5: Transport implementation can change behind these file/git operations while service contracts remain stable.
sixBar.B6: Production box routing cannot be replaced by default host helpers. Existing real filesystem/git tests own I/O correctness and service tests own transactional sync.

seams.name: GitRunner / scanCandidates and trackedPaths injection

sixBar.B1: Host and box repositories require the same ignored-candidate and literal-tracked-file protocols, with actual git execution on the correct machine and shutdown aborts.
